26fb9d7bf8.why: Remove five instructions producing dead final outputs and four instructions producing the unused high half of a packed intermediate. The final shuffle reads only that intermediate's low 64 bits, and the final VEX instruction still clears the upper half of ymm0.

509faa1960.why: Both permuted loads and rounded products are required, and the shared broadcast is itself a preserved result.

223fb454ba.why: Both levels of word interleaving are needed to produce ymm0 and ymm1 while preserving the intermediate in ymm3.

e7822b79ff.why: Each of the four instructions produces a distinct required vector result with its upper 128 bits cleared.

4e09548edf.why: The two stages of word interleaving produce distinct required outputs, including the first-stage value retained in ymm3.

c0f5fe4145.why: Every assembled or shuffled vector is preserved, and negating the arbitrary broadcast words requires both zeroing and subtraction.

c9023b8cd7.why: The interleaving stages and separately rounded products all feed required outputs, and arbitrary loaded factors prevent combining the arithmetic stages.

7c1fce49d1.why: The successive rounded multiplications and four broadcast results are required, and folding the scalar factor loads into vector memory operands would read additional addresses.

1f2dc69d03.why: The four scaled intermediates and both transpose stages are required, including the scaled intermediate retained in ymm4.

045ec5d4c1.why: Four independent preserved extraction results require four vector destination writes.

14ad35603e.why: All four insertions, the preserved broadcast, and the two independent within-lane shuffles are required.

a91add37ef.why: All four rounded products and both transpose stages contribute to preserved results, including ymm4 and the broadcast in ymm5.

60caac438d.why: The block writes no memory and changes only unpreserved vector registers; all required registers, including ymm0, already retain their input values.

a8ac183c83.why: The reversed interleaving, four rounded products, and final transpose all feed preserved outputs, including the intermediate in ymm4.
